narr: A large cluster of thunderstorms stalled near the coast in the Florida panhandle and produced very heavy rain with 6 to 12 inches of rain recorded. This caused widespread flash flooding around Pensacola. The thunderstorms also produced wind damage.
ev: Heavy rain caused flooding along N Davis Highway from Creighton to Olive Road.
Heavy rain caused numerous reports of flooding across southern Escambia County.
Heavy rain caused flooding of numerous structures and ongoing highwater rescues ongoing.
Heavy rain caused flooding and closed Gulf Breeze Parkway.
Heavy rain caused flooding in the Pensacola area with reports of residents evacuating in Brent along Carpenters creek due to water rapidly rising.
Heavy rain caused flooding of numerous roads around the Pensacola area.
Heavy rain closed Texas at 16th avenue due to flooding.
Heavy rain closed Langley Avenue from Davis highway to Hermitage drive due to flooding.
